question_text: Choose the correct heading for: A
options: A shift in our fact-finding habits
The origins of online social networks
Information that could change how you live
A change in how we view our online friendships
explanation:
Reading Passage 3 has seven paragraphs, A–G.
Choose the correct heading for paragraphs B–G from the list of headings below.
source_reference: Official Guide to IELTS Academic Test 7
passage_text: WANT TO BE FRIENDS? Could the benefits of online social networking be too good to miss out on? A For many hundreds of thousands of people worldwide, online networking has become enmeshed in our daily lives. However, it is a decades-old insight from a study of traditional social networks that best illuminates one of the most important aspects of today's online networking.
